source_document.title: MetaIndux-TS: Frequency-Aware AIGC Foundation Model for Industrial Time Series
source_document.venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Networks and Learning Systems, vol. 36, no. 10, October 2025

repeat_reporting: The paper states that all experiments were repeated five times and average values were used for final results.

predictive_rmse.definition: Predictive Score; RMSE after training an LSTM on generated data. Lower is better.

discriminative_score.definition: Absolute difference between RNN discriminator accuracy and 0.5. Lower is better.

audit_note: Both metrics are published generated-data point estimates; the paper does not publish per-seed values or standard deviations.
